scope: CAD B5-B face sketch and B5-C reviewed face cut
checks: face-local drawing and driving dimensions project to the exact BRep face frame and regenerate an extrusion
source translation and rotation refresh face axes, projection, extrusion and cut
reviewed blind/through Boolean cut owns source and sketch inputs, removes measured volume and creates one Undo entry; side-face circular cut follows its local normal
reverse or empty cuts reject atomically; source-face key loss requires explicit rebind and blocks STEP export
document v19 reload, Undo/Redo and actual STEP transfer
limitations: One closed profile without holes; no face-sketch Offset/Trim/Extend, free grip/stretch or free rotation
Changed face topology keys require explicit rebind; unresolved results retain the last geometry for review
